cues: Authenticate users, then authorise them: GRANT and REVOKE give each user exactly the privileges they need.
Encrypt data, keep backups and logs, and never paste a user's input straight into a query, which is how SQL injection attacks work.
text: Finally, security. Authenticate users, then authorise them: GRANT and REVOKE give each user exactly the privileges they need. Views hide sensitive columns. Encrypt data, keep backups and logs, and never paste a user's input straight into a query, which is how SQL injection attacks work.
